card.name: Start of the word contraindicated
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word contraindicated (or contraindications), split as contr- or CONTR-, right after is/are or barring. It appears in label sections on contraindications, overdose and emesis warnings.

modes.label: After is/are
modes.description: The word 'contraindicated' begins after a form of 'to be' in a statement about patients or a drug.
modes.example: Alogliptin and metformin HCl tablets are<< contr>>aindicated in patients with an e

modes.label: Capitalized warning
modes.description: The upper-case form CONTR begins CONTRAINDICATED in a warning line.

modes.label: Barring contraindications
modes.description: The start of 'contraindications' appears after 'barring' in overdose advice.
modes.example: barring<< contr>>aindications such as coma, conv

card.writes: It promotes 'again' words and suppresses 'anti'-type tokens, so the output effect is unclear and probably not meaningful.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of the word contraindicated, just before the rest of the word is completed.
